title: From canvas to wearable fragment
asset_strategy: Lead with the raw painting as source evidence, move into reconstruction signals using design assets and process frames, then resolve into on-body product proof with one premium campaign shot. Keep the sequence sparse and procedural so the transformation reads instantly: canvas → capture → reconstruct → wear.

slides.headline: SOURCE
slides.notes: Full-bleed raw painting crop on bone background, minimal archive framing, high tension.

slides.headline: SCAN
slides.notes: Use the pixelated reconstruction as a technical proof layer, sparse and severe.

slides.headline: SYSTEM
slides.notes: Treat the design asset like an archive label and reconstruction map, not a poster.

slides.headline: REBUILD
slides.notes: Pair process evidence with a clean fragment crop; make the translation legible.

slides.headline: BODY
slides.notes: Premium campaign frame with styled body, oversized silhouette, concrete/glass/metal context.

slides.headline: WORN
slides.notes: Alternate crop or angle to emphasize garment presence, confidence, and textile texture.
